meta.name: git-master
meta.description: MUST USE for ANY git operations. Atomic commits, rebase/squash, history search (blame, bisect, log -S). STRONGLY RECOMMENDED: Use with task(category='quick', load_skills=['git-master'], ...) to save context. Triggers: 'commit', 'rebase', 'squash', 'who wrote', 'when was X added', 'find the commit that'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 管理 Git 提交、变基、搜索历史
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常用 Git 管理代码版本
copy.tagline_en: Manage Git commits, rebase, and search history
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you frequently use Git for version control

howto.what: Claude会判断请求类型(提交/rebase/查历史),按仓库现有风格与语言写提交信息;强制按目录拆成多个原子提交,先给计划再执行。
howto.when: 当你说出'commit'、'rebase'、'squash'等关键词,或要求查代码历史,或进行任何git操作时触发。

say.text: 帮我把这次改动按目录拆成多个原子提交。
say.note: 它先分析文件再给拆分计划。

say.text: 把最近三个提交用squash合并成一个。
say.note: 会按你的仓库风格重写提交信息。

say.text: 查一下这段代码是谁在哪个提交里加的。
say.note: 触发历史搜索,定位引入该代码的提交。

howto.what_en: After install, Claude detects the request type (commit/rebase/history lookup), follows the repo's existing commit style and language, splits multi-file changes into multiple atomic commits by directory/concern, and prints the plan before executing.
howto.when_en: When you say commit, rebase, squash, ask to look up history, or perform any git operation.

say_en.text: Split these changes into multiple atomic commits by directory.
say_en.note: It will analyze files and print a commit plan first.

say_en.text: Squash the last three commits into one.
say_en.note: It will rewrite the message using your repo style.

say_en.text: Find who added this line and in which commit.
say_en.note: Triggers history lookup to locate the introducing commit.
